title: Natural frequencies of a cantilever (Euler–Bernoulli)
source: Euler–Bernoulli beam: f_n = (β_n L)²/(2π L²)·√(EI/ρA), β₁L = 1.8751, β₂L = 4.6941; Timoshenko, Young and Weaver, Vibration Problems in Engineering, 4th ed., Wiley 1974, §5.3

quantities.quantity: first bending frequency (modes 1 and 2 are the y and z pair)
quantities.reason: Euler–Bernoulli neglects shear and rotary inertia, which lower f1 by about 0.2% at L/h = 20
as f1: a square section bends alike in y and z
shear and rotary inertia lower the second mode by about 1% at L/h = 20 (Timoshenko)
